problem.paragraph: Show that the limit $$\underset{(x,y)\rightarrow(0,0)}{\lim }\frac{5x^{2}y}{x^{2} + y^{2}}$$ exists and is the same along the paths: $$y \text{-axis}$$ and $$x \text{-axis,}$$ and along $$y = x.$$

exercises.paragraph: For the following exercises, evaluate the limits at the indicated values of $$x \text{and} y.$$ If the limit does not exist, state this and explain why the limit does not exist.

solution.paragraph: The limit does not exist because when $$xx$$ and $$yy$$ both approach zero, the function approaches $$ln0,ln0,$$ which is undefined (approaches negative infinity).

solution.paragraph: every open disk centered at $$(x0,y0)(x0,y0)$$ contains points inside $$RR$$ and outside $$RR$$

solution.paragraph: The limit does not exist. The function approaches two different values along different paths.

problem.paragraph: (Hint: Show that the function approaches different values along two different paths.)

solution.paragraph: The function is continuous at $$(0,0)(0,0)$$ since the limit of the function at $$(0,0)(0,0)$$ is $$0,0,$$ the same value of $$f(0,0).f(0,0).$$

problem.paragraph: Determine whether $$g(x,y) = \frac{x^{2} - y^{2}}{x^{2} + y^{2}}$$ is continuous at $$\left( {0,0} \right).$$

solution.paragraph: The function is discontinuous at $$(0,0).(0,0).$$ The limit at $$(0,0)(0,0)$$ fails to exist and $$g(0,0)g(0,0)$$ does not exist.

problem.paragraph: Create a plot using graphing software to determine where the limit does not exist. Find where in the coordinate plane $$f(x,y) = \frac{1}{x^{2} - y}$$ is continuous.
Determine the region of the $$xy \text{-plane}$$ in which the function $$g(x,y) = \arctan \left( \frac{xy^{2}}{x + y} \right)$$ is continuous. Use technology to support your conclusion.

solution.paragraph: Since the function $$arctanxarctanx$$ is continuous over $$(-\infty ,\infty ),(-\infty ,\infty ),$$ $$g(x,y)=arctan(xy2x+y)g(x,y)=arctan(xy2x+y)$$ is continuous where $$z=xy2x+yz=xy2x+y$$ is continuous. The inner function $$zz$$ is continuous on all points of the $$xy-planexy-plane$$ except where $$y=-x.y=-x.$$ Thus, $$g(x,y)=arctan(xy2x+y)g(x,y)=arctan(xy2x+y)$$ is continuous on all points of the coordinate plane except at points at which $$y=-x.y=-x.$$
